title: Cerebro Upgrade Manifest
description: Declares file ownership for /cerebro-upgrade. Controls which files are overwritten, merged, or left untouched during a template sync.

entries.description: Ordered list of ownership declarations. Earlier entries take precedence for overlapping globs.

path.description: Glob pattern or exact path relative to the project root

ownership.description: template: overwrite silently (Gate C fires in --strict mode); merge: show unified diff, Gate A on conflict; user: never touched

notes.description: Human-readable rationale for this ownership classification
